notes: The home page's hero: a floating island of meadow, tapering to a clod of earth, with a small start-up on it. A studio deck against one brick wall, where a developer and an agent (the classic robot) type side by side; a coffee bar a blue agent runs; a meeting rug someone paces round on the phone; and the meadow, where someone pets the cat, an agent walks its rounds along the stepping stones, and J. Law stands (the Ask bubble sits over him). Five people and three agents, with room to breathe.

Every piece is a group with a data-enter role, which the entrance builds up: shadow, ground (a tile, with the earth under it and the wall on it), object and sky. The three walkers (coffee-run, pacer, rounds) walk closed loops of 12 tiles, so the scene loops every 26.4 s.
The objects are copies from the jlawcordova-vlog studio (studio-import.json): change them there.
